description: List the most popular FRED series in a category. Category IDs are numeric (e.g. 32991 = Interest Rates, 32263 = Money Stock, 9 = National Accounts). Use this to browse FRED structurally rather than via search.

category_id.description: FRED category ID. See https://fred.stlouisfed.org/categories/ for the hierarchy.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 50 for observations, 25 for catalog queries).

name: fred_category_series
